scope: Methodology, Plant Intelligence, phases, launch, private check-ins and global reference bootstrap; source reads only, no DB or provider calls

features.title: Deterministic fact-snapshot assembly
permissions: Authenticated tenant context; see module spec authority table
validation: All feature queries tenant-scoped, ignore soft-deleted/inapplicable records; snapshotVersion and generatedAt recorded
failures: Missing church throws; empty evidence is explicit, never a zero-health pass
features.decision: Keep deterministic facts and a single injected asOf clock; replace many independent reads with a defined consistent snapshot transaction or explicit source revision watermark.
acceptance_criteria: Fixed asOf and one consistent source revision produce identical facts; a racing correction either belongs wholly to the snapshot or remains dirty for the next one.

features.title: Committed adult growth, first commitments and flat streak
permissions: Authenticated tenant context; see module spec authority table
validation: 50/100 are methodology benchmarks, not universal success rules
features.decision: Keep committed adult definitions; deduplicate earliest commitment per person, rolling 28-day vs prior28, one new adult resets flat streak; 21 slowed/28 stalled are approved v1 language floors.
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate commitments do not double adults; one new adult resets flat streak; 20/21/27/28-day fixtures respect vocabulary floors.

features.title: Growth source composition and unknown source counts
permissions: Authenticated tenant context; see module spec authority table
validation: Count only committed set; no individual names to oversight
failures: Mostly unknown sources must be described as unobserved
features.decision: Preserve planter-only source mix and unknown-source count; source attribution is not conversion or spiritual fruit; do not introduce conversion scoring.
acceptance_criteria: Source counts sum over committed adults only; unknown sources remain unknown; no source mix enters oversight or conversion judgment.

features.title: Vision meeting cadence, completed attendance and trend
permissions: Authenticated tenant context; see module spec authority table
features.decision: Keep completed vision-meeting data, latest/previous attendance, predictable cadence and new-attendee interpretation; target14, watch21, direct28 days; never chastise weekly cadence.
acceptance_criteria: Only completed vision meetings affect cadence; weekly rhythm gets no excessive-frequency warning; day 21 and 28 have distinct voice.

features.title: Core group cohesion and leader disengagement pattern
permissions: Authenticated tenant context; see module spec authority table
validation: Leader flag is qualitative, not an invented numeric weight
features.decision: Preserve 28-day vs prior28 attendance; disengagement=no recent attendance after prior attendance; active committed denominator, threshold20%, minimum3, leader presence makes tone more direct. No claim about spiritual unity or causes.
acceptance_criteria: Three of twelve qualifies and four of seventy does not; dormant people do not dilute active denominator; leader flag changes tone, not arithmetic.

features.title: Eight ministry coverage readings
permissions: Authenticated tenant context; see module spec authority table
failures: Main picks first name-sorted matching team; broad synonyms and admin/finance catalog mismatch require explicit mapping
features.decision: Keep the eight Playbook ministry areas, while replacing name-substring matching with stable canonical ministry-area mappings so rename/duplicate/synonym choices do not change coverage.
acceptance_criteria: Renaming a mapped ministry or adding an unrelated synonym-named team does not change canonical coverage; ambiguous custom mapping is explicit.

features.title: Leadership candidate signals and human interview/4Cs references
permissions: Plant owner assessment; no person-level insight to oversight
validation: No interview is unknown evidence, not a bad interview
features.decision: Preserve60-day behavioral conversation signal, opaque person IDs, countable tenure/attendance/serving and latest recorded human interview/4Cs results. No automated pastoral/character/doctrine/fitness verdict.
acceptance_criteria: Missing interview remains unknown; recorded interview/4Cs may be cited but no output manufactures doctrine/character/pastoral fitness.

features.title: Training program/member completion readings
permissions: Authenticated tenant context; see module spec authority table
features.decision: Keep denominator and team training definition explicit; no programs/no assignees is unknown rather than100%; use shared training operation contracts.
acceptance_criteria: No programs or no eligible members renders unknown/N/A rather than 100%; revocation and former-member rules use training source contract.

features.title: Launch countdown, status, milestones and outcome facts
permissions: Authenticated tenant context; see module spec authority table
features.decision: Read canonical launch date/status/outcome and readiness only from launch domain. Completion never changes phase; use one day/time contract.
acceptance_criteria: Launch workspace, snapshot and oversight use the identical canonical date/status/outcome; recording never advances phase.

features.title: Legacy person-record follow-up staleness facts
permissions: Authenticated tenant context; see module spec authority table
validation: Main cohort=attendee/following_up/interviewed first-time contacts; warm attended within14days
failures: Legacy facts still enter alpha judge although separate actual-contact/task metrics landed
features.decision: Keep historical snapshots interpretable, but replace person.updatedAt proxy for new v3 output: editing a profile is not contact. Reconcile v1 warm7/cold14 language with user-approved alpha task warnings before new rubric packaging.
acceptance_criteria: Profile text edits never count as actual contact in new snapshots; historical fields remain explicitly identified as legacy proxies.

features.title: Measured task follow-up ownership
permissions: Authenticated tenant context; see module spec authority table
features.decision: Keep unowned/stale-unowned per-contact and distinct/planter owner per-task facts; demoted/removed/noncommitted assignees count unowned. Never infer planter bottleneck from staleness.
acceptance_criteria: Removed/demoted/noncommitted assignees count unowned; stale task volume alone cannot blame the planter.

features.title: 48-hour originating-meeting follow-up task metric
permissions: Authenticated tenant context; see module spec authority table
validation: Pending under48h not failures; future creation/completion ignored; soft-deleted meetings retained as evidence
features.decision: Preserve alpha: mature obligations only; denominator undeleted top-level follow_up tasks with same-plant originating meeting and valid followUpStartedAt; no_longer_needed excluded and counted waived, manual/missing provenance unmeasured; success completion after creation/start and by start+48h.
acceptance_criteria: Pending under 48 hours is excluded; valid originating meeting clock governs completion; waived/manual/foreign provenance is counted separately.

features.title: Actual contact freshness independent of task completion
permissions: Authenticated tenant context; see module spec authority table
features.decision: Preserve alpha lastContactAt actual-success evidence: measured only finite nonfuture timestamps, recent strictly younger than 14 days; missing/future contact unknown. Task completion never silently establishes actual contact.
acceptance_criteria: Only finite nonfuture actual-contact timestamps count; exactly 14 days is not recent; absent evidence is unknown.

features.title: Eight-lens measured/attested/unknown evidence profile
permissions: Authenticated tenant context; see module spec authority table
validation: No inferred-fact state; inference belongs to judgment
features.decision: Keep absence distinct from health; recompute profile from versioned snapshot consistently for prompt/read validator, retain attestation age. Revisit cohesion using vision-only isMeasured and split generosity/funding semantics rather than silently extrapolate.
acceptance_criteria: Every lens has evidence quality; missing/old snapshot fields cannot generate positive health; prayer and funding/giving remain distinguishable.

features.title: Seven manual attestation toggles and reaffirmation
permissions: Plant Owner/Admin phase.signal
validation: Closed key enum, boolean current input; stale remains attested with age
failures: Write marks dirty after durable upsert; fresh assessment may lag
features.decision: Keep values_documented, financial_base_established, core_group_giving, prayer_leader_assigned, prayer_rhythm_established, prayer_in_gatherings, systems_tested;30day reaffirm for giving/prayer rhythms. Keep who/when; add correction history instead of losing previous attestations.
acceptance_criteria: All seven keys accept only their typed values; wrong key denied; aged prayer/giving can reaffirm without erasing original history.

features.title: Active and historical rubric version registry
permissions: Authenticated tenant context; see module spec authority table
validation: Record rubric content hash, not only mutable v1 label in future
features.decision: Preserve authoritative approved v1 and registered v0 provenance; create an immutable content-addressed reference package with prose/prompt generation from a single reviewed source. Do not silently author v2 methodology.
acceptance_criteria: Each assessment binds exact approved rubric hash; v0 replay selects v0 and cannot silently reinterpret under mutable v1 text.

features.title: Phase-filtered dense/sparse methodology retrieval
permissions: Authenticated tenant context; see module spec authority table
failures: safeRetrieve currently catches any error to[]; surface degraded grounding in v3
features.decision: Keep global-only approved reference corpus, pgvector cosine plus Wiki FTS reciprocal-rank fusion; dense phase/null restriction and sparse all-phase boost are distinct. Return passage IDs/hashes and canonical slugs.
acceptance_criteria: Retrieval returns only approved global content and recorded passage provenance; a shortened corpus has no stale current passage.

features.title: Typed dual-audience judge and product-rule validation
permissions: Authenticated tenant context; see module spec authority table
validation: Title 3–140/body 10–1200 characters; category/audience/severity closed enums; citedFacts nonempty; generated summary 10–600 characters
failures: Prompt-only claim floors and person/body leak prevention still require semantic evaluation
Generated overall summary is validated but not persisted by the current publication path; decide explicitly whether to preserve it in v3 or retain only persisted findings.
features.decision: Keep plain TS structured pipeline; audience coverage, three planter action slots, network register, planter pairing and unknown-not-positive guards. Add exact fact-path/value/numeric claim validation: nonempty citation strings alone do not prove truth.
acceptance_criteria: Reject invalid category/audience/budget/unknown-positive/pairing output and false FactRef values; valid structured shape alone is not labeled truthful.

features.title: Bounded corrective draft retries
permissions: Authenticated tenant context; see module spec authority table
failures: Budget exhaustion fails judgment while retaining last complete
features.decision: Keep separate output-correction ladder: default 3 drafts, accumulated named rule violations, same grounded snapshot, run deadline bound; do not multiply SDK/provider retries invisibly.
acceptance_criteria: A later draft receives cumulative named corrections; attempts/deadline bound retries; invalid drafts never reach current assessment.

features.title: Provider throttling, backoff and learned token pacing
permissions: Authenticated tenant context; see module spec authority table
failures: Manual trigger/another cron can consume same provider budget outside process-local pacer
features.decision: Keep Retry-After/header-informed shared budget,429 deferral distinct from 5 xx/output failure, SDK maxRetries0, default 4 attempts and deadline on all waits; simplify into one provider adapter with injectable clock.
acceptance_criteria: 429 follows Retry-After and defers distinctly; 5xx retry waits are deadline-bound; SDK retries do not multiply budget invisibly.

features.title: Dirty-or-seven-day-stale assessment scheduling
permissions: Cron bearer secret constant-time, missing secret rejects all
validation: Main batch maximum 10 / soft budget 270 seconds / maximum duration 300 seconds; actual deployed cadence not in vercel.json
failures: No proven cross-run lease or in-flight cancellation; process deadline limits retries, not full request latency
Candidate query loads every church and all complete assessment history before in-memory latest selection; no onboarding/readiness eligibility filter is applied here.
features.decision: Keep dirty/never-assessed/stale semantics and oldest-first starvation control. Query latest complete assessment per plant in SQL and define explicit eligibility for freshly created, inactive or retired plants. Use a separate job worker with per-plant lease/idempotency key and bounded cohorts; preserve run summary counts and operator trigger.
acceptance_criteria: Concurrent ticks claim a revision once; oldest waiting plant progresses; summary arithmetic and attempted token costs remain consistent.
Candidate query stays bounded as history grows; explicit eligibility policy does not silently exclude a formerly assessed plant or repeatedly bill an unready fresh plant.

features.title: Pending/complete/failed/deferred snapshots and recovery
permissions: Authenticated tenant context; see module spec authority table
failures: Current insert insights then complete update are separate writes; crashes can strand pending rows; post-complete event failure cannot demote dueCAS
features.decision: Keep immutable point-in-time runs and last good complete fallback; transactionally publish insight rows + complete pointer and durable side effects. Recover abandoned pending runs by lease timeout. Failed and deferred are separate operational states.
acceptance_criteria: Crash at every publication step preserves prior complete read; expired pending lease recovers; post-complete event failure cannot demote result.

features.title: Insight persistence, severity/rank and snapshot deltas
permissions: Authenticated tenant context; see module spec authority table
validation: Article slugs survive only if retrieved, case/slash normalized to corpus spelling; critical currently reserved
failures: Individual detection is cited-path heuristic, does not validate every body token
features.decision: Preserve stable urgency order, positive→info/info→low/watch→medium/urgent→high mapping, per-snapshot what-changed delta; replace dual enum mapping with one canonical vocabulary in v3 while legacy labels stay explainable.
acceptance_criteria: Only retrieved canonical slugs persist; stable urgency/rank and first/later deltas are deterministic; individual facts never survive oversight publication.

features.title: Cached assessment reads, as-of and seen marker
permissions: /phase plant Owner only; no owner→dashboard
failures: Multiple newest reads may race; v3 fetch one AssessmentView version per surface
features.decision: Keep latest complete cached reads with zero model calls; as-of/delta distinguish stale/current. Move seen write to explicit authenticated acknowledgment operation instead of read-component side effect.
acceptance_criteria: Page load performs zero model calls and reads one AssessmentView version; explicit acknowledgment releases the intended snapshot only.

features.title: Primary focus, two supplements, separate positive surface
permissions: Authenticated tenant context; see module spec authority table
features.decision: Preserve one primary focus plus at most two supplemental nonpositive work items, separate positive observations, stable sectioned reading and saved drafts. Keep the short actionable view rather than expanding into a generic report.
acceptance_criteria: Three nonpositive work items maximum with one primary and two supplements; earned positives remain separate; refresh preserves unsaved draft.

features.title: Human-readable citations and exact snapshot drill-down
permissions: Authenticated tenant context; see module spec authority table
failures: Unknown/unresolvable citation must stay unverifiable, never invented evidence
features.decision: Preserve cited evidence resolving against stored snapshot, attestation key/index resolution and familiar same-meaning language. Simplify ad hoc citation grammar to typed FactRef path+value+provenance, while legacy decoders read old forms.
acceptance_criteria: Every rendered citation resolves to its stored fact value; unknown/malformed/indexed attestation refs stay unverifiable rather than inferred.

features.title: CSF scorecard eight evidence-aware lens standings
permissions: Authenticated tenant context; see module spec authority table
features.decision: Keep eight persistent tiles and distinct not-raised/unknown/positive/watch states; absence of insight not healthy. Derive only from authorized assessment insights.
acceptance_criteria: All eight tiles distinguish unknown, not raised and positive; privacy-filtered severity alone drives displayed standing.

features.title: Phase exit criteria cluster, measured progress and evidence
permissions: Authenticated tenant context; see module spec authority table
features.decision: Keep per-phase advisory criteria and the five-indicator Phase 1 cluster without weights or magic headcount. Separate deterministic met/not_met/unknown from judge severity and criteria not currently tracked.
acceptance_criteria: Phase 1 exposes all five indicators with no weighted score; deterministic progress and judge evidence do not override Owner phase choice.

features.title: Persisted historical trends with engine-derived alerts
permissions: Authenticated tenant context; see module spec authority table
validation: Missing old metric fields=unmeasured, never zero; authorized insight severities alone drive alerts
features.decision: Keep last 12 snapshot history, current/previous movement, original snapshot facts rather than recomputing old activity; alpha preserves five independent metrics including task 48 h and actual-contact freshness.
acceptance_criteria: History reads original snapshot values; absent alpha fields are unmeasured; task completion and actual contact use separate denominators.

features.title: Milestone timeline of declared/moved phases and launch
permissions: Authenticated tenant context; see module spec authority table
features.decision: Keep chronological actual initial declaration/transition/Launch Sunday story and severity badges; never manufacture prior ladder phases for a plant joining midjourney.
acceptance_criteria: A phase-3 initial declaration displays one declaration, not invented phase-1/2 events; badges use the same authorized assessment.

features.title: Oversight privacy-safe four-valued health rollup
permissions: Associated network/sending-church seats; individual CRM unavailable; coach assignment scope separate
validation: No visible assessment/shared bearing content must not imply health; toggles do not authorize hidden raw snapshots
features.decision: Keep on-track/watch/readiness/limited-visibility classifications. Readiness needs launch within 30 days plus unresolved roles/training, not a close date alone. Filter consent on every read, withhold persons, and re-audit ungated categories and multi-feature facts.
acceptance_criteria: Consent off removes associated facts on next read; no data yields limited visibility; near launch without gaps does not escalate.

features.title: Planter-paired concerns and seen-or-72-hour release
permissions: Authenticated tenant context; see module spec authority table
features.decision: Keep the same underlying concern visible to the planter and conservatively phrased to oversight. The current seen-or-72-hour fallback may release without opening; explicitly confirm that policy against literal planter-sees-first wording before v3 launch.
acceptance_criteria: Network concerns have evaluated corresponding planter concern IDs; unseen release obeys the explicitly approved 72-hour or stricter policy.

features.title: Per-insight feedback rating and optional comment
permissions: Source self.write any session but action requires own user.churchId and church access; FRD coach feedback not actually reached by no-church coach
validation: Useful/not_useful enum, comment bounded, tenant-owned insight required
features.decision: Preserve one current feedback rating per insight/user, assessment/rubric linkage and prefilled UI. Feedback is human-reviewed evaluation input, never an automatic rubric change.
acceptance_criteria: Cross-plant insight denied; repeat own rating updates current row; optional comment bounded; feedback cannot automatically activate a rubric.

features.title: Cold-start queued/quiet guidance
permissions: Authenticated tenant context; see module spec authority table
features.decision: Keep neutral missing evidence/first useful step, queued-after-material-event vs quiet/unassessed distinction. No fake positives to satisfy dual-audience schema.
acceptance_criteria: Brand-new/quiet/queued plants get honest first-step guidance and never a fake positive based on no evidence.

features.title: Judge observability and graceful optional tracing
permissions: Authenticated tenant context; see module spec authority table
failures: Unconfigured tracing noops, so no proof of deployed monitoring
features.decision: Keep rubric/model/snapshot metadata, token usage, failure/retry rules and operator monitoring. Tracing failure cannot break assessment. Current adapter records metadata/usage rather than full prompts/responses claimed by older prose; define redacted minimum trace fields.
acceptance_criteria: Unconfigured or failed tracing cannot change job result; configured metadata includes exact versions, usage and rejection class without private check-ins.

features.title: Offline fleet eval, assessment trigger and language audit tooling
permissions: Operator only, isolated eval tenancy
validation: Semantic tests include vocab floors, growthsource only planter, no wellbeing verdict; passing typed tests not proof of domain quality
features.decision: Keep synthetic versioned representative fixtures and SME-reviewed evaluation before model/rubric rollout. Rewrite DB-destructive fixture seeding to isolated disposable test environment; never execute historical seed against shared source DB.
acceptance_criteria: Representative synthetic fleet checks semantic floors, no wellbeing verdict, source privacy and grounding; failures are reviewed before model/rubric rollout.

features.title: Material-event dirty marking and refresh semantics
permissions: Authenticated tenant context; see module spec authority table
failures: Current markPlantDirty swallows logs; lost marks delay7days; no general durable bus
features.decision: Keep freshness after attendance/team/person/task/phase/signal/outcome changes; inventory all material corrections/deletions too. Replace best-effort missed dirty events with transactionally bumped source revision plus periodic stale fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Every material correction/deletion/retirement increments relevant source revision atomically; lost external delivery cannot hide changed evidence.

features.title: Private weekly four-dimension planter check-in
permissions: Alpha Owner-only phase.declare corrects main Admin-capable phase.signal write mismatch
validation: Note max2000; all four enums required; no dirty marker/events
features.decision: Preserve four spiritually/marriage-family/financially/pace answers using steady/strained/struggling and an optional note. Server-derived Monday and unique church/week make current-week answering idempotent; alpha keeps revisions. No AI, readiness, oversight, coach or Evry access by default.
acceptance_criteria: Owner-only current save requires all four enums, derives week on server and produces no assessment/AI/oversight/event side effect.

features.title: Private 12-week strip and three-consecutive-struggling nudge
permissions: Plant Owner only
features.decision: Keep the private 12-week strip and a nudge after three consecutive struggling weeks to seek human support. A missing week breaks the run. No inferred pastoral concern or generated counseling.
acceptance_criteria: Three consecutive struggling answers nudge; a missing week breaks streak; no private values leave the care projection.

features.title: Full private check-in history with preserved revisions
permissions: Only current plant Owner, never org/coach/model
features.decision: Preserve alpha full history route and prior-answer revisions. Separate sensitive personal care storage/access policy from church/assessment module in v3; owner-transfer policy unresolved.
acceptance_criteria: Only authorized private owner/history subject reads full weeks and prior revisions; org/coach/Evry context cannot retrieve them.

features.title: Correct existing check-in without deleting history
permissions: Plant Owner
validation: UUID ID; enum/note validation; cannot post arbitrary week
features.decision: Preserve tenant-scoped correction of an existing week with previous values, author and time appended. No deletion surface. Add expected revision and unchanged-save no-op to prevent lost corrections or revision spam.
acceptance_criteria: Existing same-plant row only; stale revision denied; unchanged correction no history spam; original values remain available.

features.title: Accurate final-draft assessment failure diagnostics
permissions: Authenticated tenant context; see module spec authority table
features.decision: Preserve diagnostics81abfcc7: report no valid draft after N attempts and the LAST rejected rule; do not falsely claim every draft broke the same rule or that a later model response must repeat it. Add attempt-level rule history.
acceptance_criteria: A mixed-rule sequence reports attempt count and last rejection accurately without attributing that last rule to every draft.

features.title: One-time midjourney initial phase declaration
permissions: Plant Owner for declaration/change; authorized tenant readers for own journey
validation: Phase integer0..6; ordinary reason trim1..2000; reserved initial reason rejected
features.decision: Keep one attested existing-phase history row. A row lock, partial unique index and ON CONFLICT prevent double declaration; the losing request does not change phase.
acceptance_criteria: Two racing declarations produce exactly one honest row and one phase value; repeated requests do not replay fabricated progression.

features.title: Reasoned forward/backward/skipping/correcting phase transition
permissions: Plant Owner for declaration/change; authorized tenant readers for own journey
validation: Phase integer0..6; ordinary reason trim1..2000; reserved initial reason rejected
features.decision: Preserve Owner confirmation and reason, phases 0–6, fact snapshot/rubric audit and no readiness gate. Replace pre-read fromPhase with a locked aggregate or expected revision so concurrent changes preserve truthful history.
acceptance_criteria: Stale revision denied and audit fromPhase equals locked prior state; forward/backward/skip allowed with reason; readiness never hard-blocks.

features.decision: Current same-phase requests classify as noop but still append history and emit an event. Decide explicitly whether that behavior remains; no silent removal.
acceptance_criteria: Same-phase behavior follows the explicit reviewed choice, with consistent audit/event/no-op receipt.

acceptance_criteria: Corrections append attributable new history; ordinary users cannot rewrite transition authors, snapshots or timestamps.

features.title: Seven church-planting phases and Playbook criteria catalog
permissions: Plant Owner for declaration/change; authorized tenant readers for own journey
validation: Phase integer0..6; ordinary reason trim1..2000; reserved initial reason rejected
features.decision: Preserve all seven phases and reviewed criteria. Aggregate display names/criteria from the approved reference package instead of repeating constants in UI and judge modules.
acceptance_criteria: All seven reviewed phases and names resolve consistently across reference, UI, criteria and assistant lookup.

features.title: Set, move, postpone and recommit canonical launch date
permissions: Schedule/outcome Plant Owner; milestones seated own-duty; linkedtasks normal task scope
validation: YYYY-MM-DD real date; note<=2000; counts integer0..1millionnullable; outcome text<=10000
features.decision: Keep one live launch per plant and transactional date/status journal. Planning schedules, scheduled postpones or moves, postponed recommits, completed cannot be redated. Same-day recommit is a real change; unchanged save causes no write or notification.
acceptance_criteria: Concurrent first schedule writes one live row and journal; unchanged resave no-op; same-day postponed recommit schedules; completed cannot redated.

features.title: Launch date/status journal and actor names

validation: YYYY-MM-DD real date; note<=2000; counts integer0..1millionnullable; outcome text<=10000
features.decision: Keep old/new target and status, actor, reason and scheduled/moved/postponed/completed event vocabulary. Store exact outcome revisions in v3, rather than claim current journal notes preserve overwritten values.
acceptance_criteria: Journal old/new values are truthful under race; actor is session derived; full future outcome revisions are available.

features.title: Nine Playbook milestones and 22 linked prep tasks
permissions: Schedule/outcome Plant Owner; milestones seated own-duty; linkedtasks normal task scope
validation: YYYY-MM-DD real date; note<=2000; counts integer0..1millionnullable; outcome text<=10000
features.decision: Preserve nine stable milestone keys across operations, launch-team preparation and promotion, plus twenty-two linked tasks. Atomic dependent insertion and database uniqueness prevent duplicate tasks; user-deleted work does not reappear.
acceptance_criteria: Blank schedule creates nine milestones and twenty-two linked tasks once; retry and concurrent seed add no duplicates or resurrect deleted work.

features.title: Complete/reopen milestone under live-task guard
permissions: Schedule/outcome Plant Owner; milestones seated own-duty; linkedtasks normal task scope
validation: YYYY-MM-DD real date; note<=2000; counts integer0..1millionnullable; outcome text<=10000
features.decision: Keep explicit milestone completion separate from task progress. Alpha unresolved states not_started/in_progress/blocked prevent completion; complete or no_longer_needed resolves an obligation. Ignore soft-deleted tasks and allow reopening.
acceptance_criteria: Unresolved live task blocks completion; waived/deleted task does not; reopen is authorized and preserves audit history.

features.title: Launch workspace, dashboard countdown and outcome forms
